method: Desk research on 2026-10-09 using the WebSearch tool (mode 'standard') only, including allowed_domains searches restricted to official domains (gentlemonster.com, mykita.com, jacquesmariemage.com, kuboraum.com, retrosuperfuture.com, tamburins.com). WebFetch FAILED for every attempted URL (https://gentlemonster.com/au/stories/skp, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haus_Nowhere, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gentle_Monster, domusweb.it) with 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND'; curl via the agent proxy returned 403 on CONNECT (en.wikipedia.org; proxy log also shows www.gentlemonster.com and www.032c.com denied). No page was read in full, so every source is verification='snippet'. WebSearch output is a summary of results with quoted fragments; evidence below is copied from those fragments or closely paraphrased. 'official' kind = brand/magazine's own domain, but still only seen via search. Nothing was invented; items not found are in not_checked. | Post-check: claims marked 'high' were downgraded to 'medium' because no source was read in full (catalogue.validate rule: a snippet never carries high confidence).

claims.subject: gentle_monster
claims.evidence: Brand describes its philosophy as "Innovational High-End Experiments" (relayed from gentlemonster.com legacy contact page); same wording in FashionBI profile ("constantly develops its self under a philosophy of 'innovational high-end experiments'") and Matthews Asia commentary.
claims.conflicts: Wording varies: FashionUnited and END. Clothing use "high-end experimentation"; the search summary says both variants appear on the official site. No current (non-legacy) official page confirmed.

claims.subject: gentle_monster
claims.evidence: FashionUnited: the brand "constantly develops itself under a philosophy of 'high-end experimentation'"; END. Clothing frames it as a design aesthetic of "high-end experimentation".
claims.conflicts: Variant of "Innovational High-End Experiments" (see clm-gm-philosophy-wording).

claims.subject: gentle_monster
claims.evidence: "We strive to astonish the world with our main five focuses": Product, Space, Styling, Culture Redesign and Technology.
claims.conflicts: A Substack post lists a different set, "PSSCS" (Product, Space, Styling, Culture&Campaign, Service) - likely older/variant wording. Official confirmation only via legacy page relayed by search.

claims.subject: gentle_monster
claims.evidence: Founded in 2011 in Seoul; founder Hankook Kim (Kim Han-kook); parent company IICOMBINED, which also runs Tamburins, NUDAKE, ATiiSSU and Nuflaat.
claims.conflicts: ZoomInfo says it was "founded in 2011 by Jay Oh and Hankook Kim"; no other source seen names Jay Oh.
claims.confidence_note: downgraded from 'high' on 2026-10-09: every source was seen as a search snippet only, none read in full

claims.subject: gentle_monster
claims.evidence: Official "Redefinition of Eyewear" art project "questions the definition and nature of eyewear" to move past its conventional meaning, with collaborations with nine global artists.

claims.subject: gentle_monster
claims.evidence: Quantum project (Hongdae, Seoul): a series of 36 spatial installations, redesigned every 25 days through collaborations with artists and brands, running 29 months starting with 'Blank Desert'.
claims.conflicts: A 21-day cycle (sometimes repeated online) was NOT confirmed; the only detailed source says 25 days.

claims.subject: haus_nowhere
claims.evidence: Haus Nowhere is a multi-brand retail and exhibition concept from IICOMBINED housing its brands plus exhibitions, installations and food & beverage venues; by Dec 2025 five locations: two Seoul, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Bangkok.
claims.conflicts: Wikipedia article seen only via search summary; a site:en.wikipedia.org search did not surface it.

claims.subject: haus_nowhere
claims.evidence: HAUS Shanghai on Huaihai Middle Road reopened as Haus Nowhere on 7 March 2024 (Jing Daily); official HAUS SHANGHAI copy says the layout 'defies the traditional layout of commercial space that prioritize efficiency and function'.
claims.conflicts: Wikipedia (via summary) dates the Shanghai location's opening to Sept 2021 as the second site; 2021 HAUS Shanghai vs 2024 rename as Haus Nowhere. A Feb 2021 report said 'Haus Shanghai' was planned for 'this May'.

claims.subject: haus_nowhere
claims.evidence: HAUS NOWHERE SEOUL (Seongsu-dong, 433 Ttukseom-ro) opened September 2025 as IICOMBINED's new headquarters and multi-brand space, a different brand per public floor (Gentle Monster, Tamburins, ATiiSSU, NUDAKE, Nuflaat).
claims.conflicts: Height: Complex says 13 stories; Highsnobiety/Inside Retail say 14.
